'''Cole Bozman Vaderless Starship Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cole Bozman]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Docking Bay|Premiere-D-yavin4dockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Vaderless Starship Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Vaderless Starship Deck Bozman DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hi, here's what I've made as a Vaderless deck:
